notes: Segment ministries-d covers Power, New & Renewable Energy, Petroleum & Natural Gas, Coal, Mines, Steel, Heavy Industries, Department of Atomic Energy and Department of Space. Minister/MoS office sourced from the Cabinet Secretariat's official 'List of Council of Ministers with Portfolios' (as on 23.06.2026); as-of 2026-09-25 there was reshuffle speculation for exactly this cluster of energy/resource ministries (per The Week, 18-09-2026) but no confirmed change, so the 23.06.2026 portfolio list is the most current authoritative allocation. Secretary-level and CPSE Chairman/CMD holders were checked against 2025-2026 sources where possible (many against the Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell's live Governing Body page, last-updated 25-09-2026, itself). Known gaps / low-confidence holders that should be re-verified before publication: MNRE Secretary (Santosh Kumar Sarangi), Coal Secretary (Vikram Dev Dutt), Steel Secretary (Sandeep Poundrik); NTPC CMD and Power Grid (POWERGRID) CMD were both mid-succession in the research window and the named holders may already have changed; CMD/Chairman not verified at all (left vacant with a position stub) for: CEA, BEE, NEEPCO, Coal Controller, NLC India, SECI, IREDA, NISE, NIWE, GSI, Indian Bureau of Mines, Hindustan Copper, MECL, KABIL, MRPL, CPCL, ISPRL, IREL, ECIL, NSIL and IN-SPACe. BHAVINI and Uranium Corporation of India holder names come from Wikipedia infoboxes carrying stale (2016-19) financial data and should be treated as low-confidence pending direct confirmation. Coal India's seven production subsidiaries (BCCL/CCL/ECL/MCL/NCL/SECL/WCL) and CMPDI are defined as entities without individual CMD holder research (time-boxed out of scope for this pass). CERC and PNGRB are referenced only (owned by the regulators segment) as the sector regulators for Power and Petroleum & Natural Gas respectively. All minister/MoS position records themselves are owned by the council-of-ministers segment and are referenced here by canonical ID, not redefined. ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION PASS (2026-09-25): fresh 2025-26 sourcing on 58 positions (via Wikipedia infobox API, PIB, Google News aggregation, and the live PPAC governing-body page). 4 holder names were corrected (NTPC CMD, POWERGRID/PGCIL CMD, BHAVINI CMD, MOIL CMD — the file had stale/wrong names despite the notes already flagging some of these as unsettled). 9 previously-vacant CMD/DG/Controller stubs were resolved with named, sourced holders (NLC India, Hindustan Copper, CPCL, Coal Controller, GSI, IBM, ECIL, SECI; IREDA's PESB-recommended-but-unconfirmed candidate is noted without being recorded as a confirmed holder). NPCIL's CMD holder was downgraded to low confidence after finding evidence the named person's confirmed title is actually Director (Finance). See the top-level 'verification' block for the full per-position log. Remaining unresolved after this pass: CEA Chairperson, BEE DG, NEEPCO CMD, MRPL MD, ISPRL MD, MECL CMD, KABIL CMD, IREL CMD, IN-SPACe Chairman, Antrix CMD (unchanged from original), SAC/LPSC/NRSC/PRL Directors (not re-searched this pass).

entities.name: Ministry of Power
entities.description: Formulates national policy on generation, transmission and distribution of electricity, drives rural electrification and grid modernisation, and administers India's central power-sector PSUs and the electricity regulator's parent framework.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Electricity Act, 2003

entities.name: Central Electricity Authority
entities.description: Statutory technical authority under the Electricity Act, 2003 that specifies technical standards, prepares the National Electricity Plan and advises the Union government on power-sector planning; distinct from the tariff regulator CERC.

entities.name: Bureau of Energy Efficiency
entities.description: Statutory body that drives energy-efficiency policy — star-labelling of appliances, PAT (Perform-Achieve-Trade) scheme for industry, and building energy codes — under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.

entities.name: NTPC Limited
entities.description: India's largest power generation company, a Maharatna CPSE that runs coal, gas, hydro, nuclear-JV and renewable power plants and is the anchor of India's thermal generation capacity.

entities.name: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
entities.description: Central Transmission Utility that owns and operates over 85% of India's inter-state electricity transmission network; a Maharatna CPSE.

entities.name: NHPC Limited
entities.description: India's largest hydropower generation company, a Mini-Ratna-turned-Schedule-A CPSE that builds and operates hydroelectric and some renewable-energy projects across the Himalayan and north-eastern river basins.

entities.name: Power Finance Corporation Limited
entities.description: Systemically important NBFC and Maharatna CPSE that is India's largest lender to the power sector, financing generation, transmission and distribution projects; parent of REC Limited.

entities.name: REC Limited
entities.description: NBFC financing power, infrastructure and logistics projects, formerly Rural Electrification Corporation; now a subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation and slated for merger into PFC.

entities.name: SJVN Limited
entities.description: Hydro and renewable power generation CPSE jointly owned by the Union government (59.92%) and the Government of Himachal Pradesh (26.85%), originally built to develop the Sutlej basin.

entities.name: THDC India Limited
entities.description: Hydropower CPSE (originally Tehri Hydro Development Corporation) that built and runs the Tehri dam complex; jointly owned by the Union government and Uttar Pradesh, administratively a subsidiary of NTPC.

entities.name: North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited
entities.description: Hydro and thermal power generation CPSE dedicated to developing power projects across the north-eastern states; a subsidiary of NTPC.

entities.name: Damodar Valley Corporation
entities.description: India's first multi-purpose river-valley statutory authority (on the TVA model), generating and distributing power and managing flood control/irrigation across the Damodar basin in Jharkhand and West Bengal.

entities.name: Grid Controller of India Limited
entities.description: Operates India's national and regional power grids as the country's Independent System Operator, formerly the Power System Operation Corporation (POSOCO); a wholly government-owned entity.

entities.name: National Power Training Institute
entities.description: Apex training and human-resource-development institute for India's power sector, running specialised training centres across the country under the Ministry of Power.

entities.name: Energy Efficiency Services Limited
entities.description: Joint-venture CPSE of PSUs under the Ministry of Power that implements India's LED bulb (UJALA) and other energy-efficiency market-transformation programmes.

entities.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
entities.description: Nodal ministry for solar, wind, bio-energy, small-hydro and green-hydrogen policy, driving India's renewable-capacity targets and schemes such as PM Surya Ghar and the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited
entities.description: Central nodal agency for implementing India's solar (and increasingly wind, hybrid and green-hydrogen) tenders and power-purchase agreements on behalf of the government.

entities.name: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited
entities.description: NBFC CPSE (listed, Navratna-track) that provides project finance for renewable-energy and energy-efficiency ventures; the principal financing arm of MNRE.

entities.name: National Institute of Solar Energy
entities.description: MNRE's apex autonomous research, testing and training institute for solar-energy technologies, based in Gurugram.

entities.name: National Institute of Wind Energy
entities.description: MNRE's autonomous institute for wind-resource assessment, testing/certification of wind turbines and wind-energy R&D, based in Chennai.

entities.name: Sardar Swaran Singh National Institute of Bio-Energy
entities.description: MNRE's autonomous institute for research, training and demonstration in bio-energy technologies (biomass, biogas, biofuels), based in Kapurthala, Punjab.

entities.name: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
entities.description: Formulates policy on exploration, production, refining, distribution and pricing of petroleum, natural gas and petroleum products, and owns India's national oil companies.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, 1948

entities.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited
entities.description: India's largest crude-oil and natural-gas producer, a Maharatna CPSE responsible for the bulk of the country's domestic upstream (exploration & production) output onshore and offshore.

entities.name: Indian Oil Corporation Limited
entities.description: India's largest oil-marketing and refining company by volume, a Maharatna CPSE operating the country's largest refining network and fuel-retail chain.

entities.name: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited
entities.description: Maharatna oil-marketing and refining CPSE operating refineries at Mumbai, Kochi and Bina and a nationwide fuel-retail network.

entities.name: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited
entities.description: Maharatna oil-marketing and refining CPSE operating refineries at Mumbai and Visakhapatnam and a nationwide fuel-retail and LPG network.

entities.name: GAIL (India) Limited
entities.description: Maharatna CPSE and India's largest natural-gas transmission, trading, petrochemical and LPG-transmission company, operator of the national gas pipeline grid.

entities.name: Oil India Limited
entities.description: Second-largest national upstream oil & gas exploration and production CPSE (Navratna), historically centred on Assam/north-east India with a growing pan-India and overseas portfolio.

entities.name: Engineers India Limited
entities.description: Listed CPSE providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) and consultancy services for the hydrocarbon, petrochemical and process industries.

entities.name: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited
entities.description: Refining CPSE operating a large refinery-petrochemical complex at Mangaluru, Karnataka; a subsidiary of ONGC.

entities.name: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited
entities.description: Refining CPSE operating refineries at Manali and Nagapattinam in Tamil Nadu; a subsidiary of Indian Oil Corporation.

entities.name: Numaligarh Refinery Limited
entities.description: Refining CPSE operating a refinery at Numaligarh, Assam, jointly owned by Bharat Petroleum, Oil India and the Government of Assam.

entities.name: Directorate General of Hydrocarbons
entities.description: Technical arm of the Petroleum Ministry that regulates and monitors upstream exploration & production activity, administers hydrocarbon licensing rounds (OALP/HELP) and maintains India's E&P data repository.

entities.name: Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell
entities.description: Ministry think-tank/data cell that tracks petroleum-product pricing, subsidies, consumption and under-recoveries, and services the ministry's governing bodies with data and analysis.

entities.name: Indian Strategic Petroleum Reserves Limited
entities.description: Special-purpose CPSE that builds and manages India's underground strategic crude-oil reserve caverns (Visakhapatnam, Mangaluru, Padur) to cushion supply-disruption risk.

entities.name: Petroleum Conservation Research Association
entities.description: Non-profit body funded by the Ministry and the oil industry that promotes petroleum-product conservation and fuel efficiency through R&D, training and public outreach.

entities.name: Ministry of Coal
entities.description: Formulates policy on exploration and development of coal and lignite reserves, and administers Coal India Limited and other coal-sector CPSEs that supply the bulk of India's thermal-power fuel.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Coal Mines (Nationalisation) Act, 1973; Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957

entities.name: Coal India Limited
entities.description: World's largest coal-mining company by output, a Maharatna CPSE that produces roughly three-quarters of India's coal through seven production subsidiaries plus a planning/design subsidiary.

entities.name: Bharat Coking Coal Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Jharkhand.

entities.name: Central Coalfields Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Jharkhand.

entities.name: Eastern Coalfields Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around West Bengal.

entities.name: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Odisha.

entities.name: Northern Coalfields Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Madhya Pradesh.

entities.name: South Eastern Coalfields Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Chhattisgarh.

entities.name: Western Coalfields Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Maharashtra.

entities.name: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited
entities.description: Coal India's mine-planning, exploration and consultancy subsidiary, providing geological exploration, project reports and technical support to all CIL production subsidiaries.

entities.name: NLC India Limited
entities.description: Navratna CPSE that mines lignite (mainly at Neyveli, Tamil Nadu, and Barsingsar, Rajasthan) and generates thermal and renewable power from it; formerly Neyveli Lignite Corporation.

entities.name: Coal Controller's Organisation
entities.description: Statutory office that registers coal/lignite producers and consumers, verifies grade/quality declarations of coal, and administers cess and captive-mine compliance under coal-sector law.

entities.name: Ministry of Mines
entities.description: Formulates policy on survey and exploration of minerals (other than coal, petroleum and atomic minerals) and their regulated mining and development, and administers India's non-fuel mineral PSUs.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957

entities.name: Geological Survey of India
entities.description: India's principal earth-science survey and mapping organisation, founded in 1851, that carries out geological mapping, mineral exploration and natural-hazard (landslide/seismic) assessment nationwide.

entities.name: Indian Bureau of Mines
entities.description: Regulatory and technical attached office that enforces mine conservation, scientific-development and mineral-conservation rules, approves mining plans and compiles national mineral statistics.

entities.name: National Aluminium Company Limited
entities.description: Navratna, vertically integrated CPSE spanning bauxite mining, alumina refining, aluminium smelting and captive power generation, based in Odisha.

entities.name: Hindustan Copper Limited
entities.description: India's only vertically integrated copper-mining-to-refining CPSE, operating mines at Malanjkhand, Khetri and other sites.

entities.name: Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited
entities.description: CPSE specialising in mineral exploration (drilling, geological surveys) and consultancy services for coal, lignite and other minerals, based in Nagpur.

entities.name: Khanij Bidesh India Limited
entities.description: Joint-venture CPSE of NALCO, Hindustan Copper and MECL created in 2019 to identify, acquire and develop critical- and strategic-mineral assets overseas (e.g. lithium, cobalt) for India's supply security.

entities.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Aluminium Research Development and Design Centre
entities.description: Autonomous R&D institute under the Ministry of Mines dedicated to aluminium and non-ferrous-metal research, based in Nagpur.

entities.name: Ministry of Steel
entities.description: Formulates policy on the iron and steel industry and administers the steel-sector CPSEs; steel pricing/production itself is largely deregulated and market-driven since the 1990s.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Steel Authority of India Limited
entities.description: Maharatna CPSE and India's largest integrated public-sector steel producer, operating major integrated steel plants at Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, Bokaro and Burnpur.

entities.name: NMDC Limited
entities.description: Navratna CPSE and India's largest iron-ore producer/exporter by volume, also mining diamond, copper and other minerals; formerly National Mineral Development Corporation.

entities.name: Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited
entities.description: CPSE operating the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (Vizag Steel), India's first coastal-based integrated steel plant, entirely built on liquid-steel-through-blast-furnace route without any captive mines.

entities.name: MOIL Limited
entities.description: Listed CPSE and India's largest manganese-ore producer, operating mines mainly in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh; formerly Manganese Ore (India) Limited.

entities.name: MECON Limited
entities.description: CPSE providing engineering-consultancy, design and project-management services mainly for the steel, power and infrastructure sectors, based in Ranchi.

entities.name: KIOCL Limited
entities.description: CPSE that produces iron-ore/pig-iron pellets, originally built around the (now-closed) Kudremukh iron-ore mine; formerly Kudremukh Iron Ore Company Limited.

entities.name: Ministry of Heavy Industries
entities.description: Formulates policy for the capital-goods, heavy-engineering and automobile/auto-components sectors, runs the FAME/PLI electric-mobility and auto incentive schemes, and administers heavy-engineering CPSEs.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
entities.description: Maharatna CPSE and India's largest power-plant-equipment manufacturer, also making rail, defence, aerospace and renewable-energy equipment.

entities.name: Andrew Yule and Company Limited
entities.description: One of India's oldest managing-agency-turned-CPSEs (founded 1863), now a diversified small CPSE with engineering, electrical and tea-plantation businesses.

entities.name: Heavy Engineering Corporation Limited
entities.description: CPSE at Ranchi manufacturing heavy machinery for mining, steel and defence sectors; has for years operated under severe financial stress and periodic revival packages.

entities.name: Bridge and Roof Company (India) Limited
entities.description: CPSE providing heavy structural-engineering, fabrication and EPC services (bridges, industrial structures, offshore platforms), headquartered in Kolkata.

entities.name: International Centre for Automotive Technology
entities.description: Autonomous automotive testing, certification, homologation and R&D centre under the Ministry of Heavy Industries, based in Manesar, Haryana.

entities.name: Automotive Research Association of India
entities.description: Automotive homologation, testing, certification and R&D body co-operatively run by the automobile industry under the administrative umbrella of the Ministry of Heavy Industries, headquartered in Pune.

entities.name: Department of Atomic Energy
entities.description: Independent department directly under the Prime Minister responsible for nuclear power generation, nuclear-fuel-cycle facilities, nuclear research and India's strategic atomic programme; chairs also head the Atomic Energy Commission.
entities.legalBasis: Atomic Energy Act, 1962; Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Atomic Energy Commission
entities.description: Apex policy-making body for India's atomic-energy programme, chaired ex officio by the Secretary, Department of Atomic Energy, that approves DAE's plans, budgets and major programme decisions.

entities.name: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre
entities.description: India's premier multidisciplinary nuclear-research centre (est. 1954 by Homi Bhabha), covering reactor design, nuclear fuel cycle, nuclear medicine, materials science and national-security-related R&D, based at Trombay, Mumbai.

entities.name: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited
entities.description: CPSE that designs, builds and operates all of India's civil nuclear-power reactors, working under the Atomic Energy Act's requirement that nuclear generation stay government-owned.

entities.name: Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Limited
entities.description: CPSE set up to build and operate India's fast-breeder reactor programme, starting with the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) at Kalpakkam.

entities.name: Uranium Corporation of India Limited
entities.description: CPSE that mines and mills uranium ore, mainly from the Singhbhum belt in Jharkhand, to supply India's nuclear-fuel-cycle facilities.

entities.name: IREL (India) Limited
entities.description: CPSE (formerly Indian Rare Earths Limited) that mines beach-sand minerals and processes rare-earth and other strategic minerals for the nuclear, defence and electronics industries.

entities.name: Electronics Corporation of India Limited
entities.description: CPSE founded by DAE to build strategic and nuclear-grade electronics, instrumentation, e-voting machines and process-control systems for government use.

entities.name: Atomic Energy Regulatory Board
entities.description: India's nuclear and radiological safety regulator, issuing licences for and inspecting nuclear power plants, radiation facilities and the transport of radioactive material; reports administratively to DAE while functioning as an independent safety authority.
entities.legalBasis: Atomic Energy Act, 1962 (delegated authority); established by Presidential order 1983

entities.name: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research
entities.description: DAE's flagship deemed-university research institute for fundamental physics, mathematics, biology and computer science, founded with Tata Trust support in 1945 and now grant-in-aid funded by DAE.

entities.name: Homi Bhabha National Institute
entities.description: Deemed university that is the common academic umbrella for DAE's constituent research institutions (BARC, IGCAR, VECC, RRCAT, TIFR, IPR, SINP and others), awarding degrees for doctoral and integrated research training across them.

entities.name: Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research
entities.description: DAE's principal centre for fast-reactor technology and related materials science, based at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu.

entities.name: Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre
entities.description: DAE research centre in Kolkata operating cyclotron and superconducting-cyclotron accelerators for nuclear-physics, materials-science and radioisotope-production research.

entities.name: Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology
entities.description: DAE research centre in Indore developing laser and accelerator technologies, including free-electron lasers and synchrotron-radiation sources (Indus-1/Indus-2).

entities.name: Institute for Plasma Research
entities.description: DAE-funded autonomous research institute at Gandhinagar dedicated to plasma physics and fusion-energy research, including India's Aditya and SST-1 tokamaks.

entities.name: Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics
entities.description: DAE grant-in-aid research institute in Kolkata, founded by physicist Meghnad Saha, covering nuclear and particle physics, condensed-matter physics and materials science.

entities.name: Department of Space
entities.description: Independent department directly under the Prime Minister responsible for India's space programme — satellite and launch-vehicle development, space applications, and space-sector policy and promotion — executed mainly through ISRO and its associated bodies.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Space Commission
entities.description: Apex policy body for India's space programme, chaired ex officio by the Secretary, Department of Space, mirroring the Atomic Energy Commission's role for the nuclear programme.

entities.name: Indian Space Research Organisation
entities.description: India's national space agency, responsible for designing, building and launching satellites and launch vehicles (PSLV, GSLV, LVM3) and running the country's civilian space missions (Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan, Aditya-L1 and others) through a network of specialised centres.

entities.name: Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre
entities.description: ISRO's lead centre for launch-vehicle design and development, based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

entities.name: U R Rao Satellite Centre
entities.description: ISRO's lead centre for spacecraft design, integration and testing, based in Bengaluru; formerly ISRO Satellite Centre (ISAC).

entities.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre
entities.description: ISRO's primary launch site (spaceport) at Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, from which nearly all Indian orbital launches are conducted.

entities.name: Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre
entities.description: ISRO's lead centre for liquid, cryogenic and semi-cryogenic rocket-propulsion systems, with campuses at Thiruvananthapuram, Bengaluru and Mahendragiri.

entities.name: Space Applications Centre
entities.description: ISRO centre in Ahmedabad developing satellite payloads (communication, remote-sensing, meteorology, navigation) and applications of space technology for national development.

entities.name: National Remote Sensing Centre
entities.description: ISRO centre in Hyderabad that acquires and processes satellite remote-sensing data and runs India's disaster-management and geospatial-data-support services.

entities.name: ISRO Propulsion Complex
entities.description: ISRO's rocket-propulsion static-testing and propellant-production facility at Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu.

entities.name: Human Space Flight Centre
entities.description: ISRO centre coordinating India's human-spaceflight programme (Gaganyaan) — crew module, life-support, training and mission-management systems.

entities.name: ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network
entities.description: ISRO's satellite tracking, telemetry and command network, coordinating ground stations across India and overseas for satellite and launch-vehicle operations.

entities.name: ISRO Inertial Systems Unit
entities.description: ISRO centre at Thiruvananthapuram developing inertial-navigation and guidance systems for launch vehicles and spacecraft.

entities.name: North Eastern Space Applications Centre
entities.description: Joint ISRO/DoS and North Eastern Council centre in Shillong applying space technology to development needs of India's north-eastern states.

entities.name: Indian Institute of Remote Sensing
entities.description: ISRO's training and education institute in Dehradun for remote sensing, GIS and geoinformatics, offering courses to Indian and international scientists and officials.

entities.name: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology
entities.description: India's first autonomous space-sector university, set up by the Department of Space at Thiruvananthapuram to train aerospace and space-technology engineers and scientists, largely for ISRO.

entities.name: NewSpace India Limited
entities.description: CPSE (commercial arm of the Department of Space) that manufactures and transfers ISRO-developed launch vehicles and satellites to industry, sells space-based services and executes commercial launch contracts.

entities.name: Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre
entities.description: Single-window autonomous body that authorises, promotes and regulates private-sector space activities in India (satellite, launch-vehicle and ground-segment ventures), created as part of the 2020 opening-up of the space sector to private industry.

entities.name: Antrix Corporation Limited
entities.description: DoS's original commercial marketing arm, historically handling satellite-transponder leasing and technology transfer; most new commercial functions have since moved to NSIL.

entities.name: Physical Research Laboratory
entities.description: DoS-funded autonomous research institute in Ahmedabad for space and atmospheric sciences, astrophysics, planetary science and astronomy — India's leading centre for these fields.

entities.name: Central Power Research Institute
entities.description: Ministry of Power's autonomous applied-research and high-power/high-voltage testing institute for electrical equipment, headquartered in Bengaluru with regional testing labs across India.

entities.name: Nuclear Fuel Complex
entities.description: DAE production unit in Hyderabad that manufactures nuclear-fuel assemblies, zirconium-alloy reactor components and other nuclear-grade materials for India's power and research reactors.

entities.name: Heavy Water Board
entities.description: DAE production organisation operating India's heavy-water plants, which supply the moderator/coolant used in the country's PHWR nuclear power reactors.

entities.name: REC Power Distribution Company Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned subsidiary of REC Limited that provides power-distribution-reform consultancy and implements central distribution schemes (e.g. RDSS) on behalf of state utilities.

entities.name: REC Transmission Projects Company Limited
entities.description: Wholly owned subsidiary of REC Limited that incubates inter-state transmission projects, bidding them out under the tariff-based competitive bidding route before transferring them to winning developers.

positions.title: Secretary, Ministry of Power

holder.name: Pankaj Agarwal
holder.notes: IAS 1992-batch (Madhya Pradesh cadre); confirmed active and quoted as Power Secretary on 24 Sept 2026 re: draft National Electricity Policy 2026.

positions.title: Director General, Bureau of Energy Efficiency
Chairman & Managing Director

holder.name: Gurdeep Singh
holder.notes: Multiple 2026 news reports (PSU Watch, IndianMandarins, Power Peak Digest, Elets eGov) confirm Gurdeep Singh received a further six-month extension as NTPC CMD effective 2026-08-01, taking his tenure to January 2027, and that an 18-candidate search for his eventual successor was ongoing as of July 2026. This supersedes the file's prior 'Jaikumar Srinivasan' entry, which cited NTPC's own board page but could not be independently re-verified (ntpc.co.in returned a bot-protection CAPTCHA to automated fetches during this pass) and conflicts with the weight of contemporaneous news coverage.

sources: https://www.psuwatch.com (Gurdeep Singh gets second extension past retirement as NTPC CMD, tenure now runs to January 2027, 28-Jul-2026)

positions.title: Chairman & Managing Director

holder.name: Bhupender Gupta
holder.notes: SJVN has repeatedly extended Bhupender Gupta's additional charge as CMD through 2026 (most recently ~11-Sep-2026, per Elets eGov/Whispers in the Corridors/Power Peak Digest).
